verdict.rationale: Brex documents in-product AI that produces suggestions and insights from account data. Its audit agent categorizes potential policy violations by risk level, Bill Pay AI suggests the matching PO and drafts payments, and AI assistants offer policy help and write memos. A community comment independently notes AI assistants are available to all users; another calls the AI products gimmicky, but that is general skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: insights beyond expense compliance and AP workflows (e.g., spend-trend analysis, forecasting, or natural-language Q&A over data inside the product), and in-depth first-party docs or hands-on corroboration of insight quality beyond marketing pages.
